title: Peter Set Free from Prison
reflectionQuestion: Peter's friends prayed and prayed for him, and God set him free. Who is someone you would like to pray for?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Early Church, mature tier). Rescue/wonder. Herod's earlier killing of James is OMITTED entirely; the prison is kept gentle ('a heavy locked door, soldiers to guard him') with no threat of harm dwelt on -- focus is the angel + chains falling + doors opening + Peter walking free. Per Adam: lean into the Rhoda beat (she's so overjoyed she forgets to open the door) -- a funny, sweet, kid-memorable human moment. Spine: the friends' prayers are heard and answered (prayer + Gods rescue). 'God'/'Jesus' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_ARCHER (bold guide) -- rescue energy.
